caption: A rectangular sofa with segmented seat cushions, back cushions and two armrests. It includes a seat frame, rear backrest, two side armrests and segmented cushions. Legs are 0.15 frame-widths thick and connect upward to the frame. Width/depth is 1.42; height/horizontal-span is 0.65. The supports occupy four separated corner positions. Leg-gap/width is 0.69. Across 4 opaque colors, the arms is mainly blue-gray and the cushions is cream. There are 3 seat cushions. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces.
